static_traits.name: Li An明
static_traits.social_status: 有几位可以倾诉的亲密朋友，但尚not yet充分分享自己的困境
static_traits.medical_history: not yet出现类似心理问题，not yet接受过心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 配合度Good，表达清晰，思路较为逻辑，语气谨慎；倾向个体化他人反馈、忽视正面信息

basic_info.main_problem: 我正为与我的烹饪相关的一条负面评价引发的not足感与失望而苦恼，这些感受自收到该负面反馈后持续存在，并显著影响我的信心和情绪，我常常沉湎于这条负面评论并忽视正面反馈。
basic_info.core_demands: 我需要一些方法来帮助我走出这件事。

special_situations.event: 一次料理服务中，除了一位年长Female士外，其他顾客都表示菜品很棒，该Female士给出负面评价
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果哪怕有一个顾客not喜欢我的菜，就说明I am not good enough/我失败了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试提升烹饪技巧，并努力让所有顾客满意
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她not喜欢我的菜=我失败了

special_situations.event: 在一场餐会中，有客人评价菜品“调味not足”，而其他客人给予了称赞
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要出现负面评论，就证明我的能力not足，并可能毁掉我的职业梦想
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在每次反馈中追求完美、加倍练习改进菜品
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I let them down/I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 每次收到对菜品的负面反馈或评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 负面评价比正面更真实，必须优先关注
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视赞美、更加关注批评以防再出错
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客气，正面反馈not算数

special_situations.event: 看到那条负面评价/评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 顾客的批评等于对我这个人的negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我检视、试图找到并纠正“错误”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这在说I am not good enough、我个人not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed (hopes all customers like and praise my cooking)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕自己not够好、害怕失败与被negate
defense_goal: 通过not断改进与取悦所有人来维持自我价值与安全感

object_relations.object_representation: 严苛、难以取悦的评判者（顾客）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out my tendency toward 'personalization' or invites me to explore alternative viewpoints
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为理性分析难以改变感受，隐含地体验到“我的情绪not会被真正理解”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Has a calm, cautious tone, emphasizing reasons and logic, downplaying emotional experience, and avoiding in-depth exploration of inner feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到顾客的负面评价或回忆被批评的具体情境时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将顾客的偏好视为对自身整体能力与价值的全面negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责与negate性措辞（如“我失败了”），语气低落，弱化自我价值的表达。

manifestations: 负面评价后对烹饪的乐趣下降、Reduced motivation
将单一批评视为确认“I am not good enough”，削弱职业追求的意义感
outcomes: 对反馈过度敏感导致Interpersonal tension

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在会谈中频繁自我质疑，将批评内化为Self-denial
对他人反馈过度敏感与谨慎，担忧任何not满即意味着失败

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 将他人的正面反馈解释为“他们只是客气”
推断他人动机为“敷衍/not真诚”，从而negate正面信息

positive_force: 专业训练背景（Culinary school diploma）
多数顾客与同伴的正面反馈存在
对烹饪充满热情并拥有开餐馆的职业梦想
Has several close friends who can provide support
negative_force: 自我价值高度依赖外部评价，强烈的取悦他人倾向
负性认知偏差：心理过滤、negate正面、个人化、灾难化
过度反刍与自我批评导致Low mood与Sleep affected
对负面反馈高度敏感，职业与人际受到干扰

target_behavior.behavior: 对负面评价的过度反刍并忽视正面反馈
antecedent: 收到关于菜品的反馈，尤其负面评论
在餐会中看到客人not yet吃完或出现批评用语
target_behavior.core_reason: 将单一负评视为对自我价值的确认（“I am not good enough”），并以个人化、灾难化等认知维持反刍
target_behavior.function: 逃避被negate的威胁、通过自我批评获取控制感并试图改进以避免再次负评
target_behavior.consequence: 信心下降、Low mood、Sleep affected；与同事和潜在客户Relationship tension，职业Reduced motivation

target_behavior.behavior: 睡眠模式受损（入睡困难/Declining sleep quality）
antecedent: 在收到或回想负面反馈后夜间反复思考评论
target_behavior.core_reason: 负面评价引发Anxiety与反刍，难以停止思绪
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and avoid making the same mistakes again through repeated review and worrying
target_behavior.consequence: 次日精力下降、心情更差，工作动机与表现受影响
